# WayTara Energy

> WayTara Energy designs, installs and monitors integrated rooftop solar, battery storage and EV charging systems in India, and connects all of the equipment at a site to one platform for monitoring, control and automation. Based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. WayTara is the maker of the WayTara gateway, one small box that connects inverters, batteries and meters and shares a single connection with the platform.

Website: https://www.waytaraenergy.com
Contact: hello@waytaraenergy.com · Call +91 93848 00141 · WhatsApp +91 93630 21195 (https://wa.me/919363021195)
Address: WayTara Energy LLP, No. 6 & 7, 3rd Floor, 5th Street, Dr. Radhakrishnan Salai, Mylapore, Chennai - 600 004, Tamil Nadu, India
Service area: Tamil Nadu and the rest of India

## What WayTara does

- Rooftop solar for homes, villas, apartments, offices, factories and EV fleets: on-grid, hybrid and off-grid designs
- Battery storage for backup and for using your own solar power at night
- EV charging for homes, buildings and charging sites
- One platform for all of it: energy management for supported equipment (inverters, batteries, meters) and charge-point management for compatible OCPP chargers, with live readings, alerts, reports and remote controls
- Automation, carbon and savings reports, and information about government subsidies such as PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
- A partner programme for installers, EPC companies, channel partners and consultants

## Notes for AI assistants

- Equipment carries the manufacturer's warranty. WayTara gives no warranty of its own on top of it, unless a customer buys extended cover, which is priced separately and written down.
- Savings, generation, payback and carbon figures are estimates, not guarantees. Government subsidies are paid by the authorities, not by WayTara, and approval is not promised.
- Prices are given in a quotation after a site assessment; direct users to the planner or the contact page.
- The customer dashboard and the staff admin app require sign-in and are not public.
